At the end of each level is a boss, most of the time also not representing anything that appeared in the movie, such as a giant octopus that you fight on a raft or a giant scorpion in the desert.

The playable characters are Aragorn, Frodo Baggins, Gandalf, Legolas, and Gimli, who only superficially resemble their respective characters from the Peter Jackson movies and take on more anime-styled fantasy designs in the game. In all currently dumped versions (the English version and 魔戒奇兵, the original Chinese version), the characters use different names, the names used differing in each version. In the original Chinese version, Aragorn is named Shredder (史瑞德), Frodo is named Roger (羅金斯), Gandalf is named Glenda (葛蘭達), Legolas is named Alice (亞拉斯), and Gimli is named Jerry (傑力). In the English version, Aragorn is named Sherd (he is named "SherdSherd" in the intro), Frodo is named Rojins, Gandalf is named Granda ("GrandaGranda" in the intro), Legolas is named Alias, and Gimli is named Jali. 

The Chinese version of the game was developed and published by Vast Fame.  The English version was published by New Game Color Advance.

218016.overview:
Spooky Mission 2 is the sequel to Spooky Mission.

Samus, ever the fool, decided to jump down Ing Ing’s pitfall trap during the escape, and was crushed by the falling pumpkin at the end of her quest to stop Imago from bringing eternal Christmas.

But what’s this? Imago has returned??? And he’s threatening to bring eternal Christmas again? Samus turns in her grave, and her soul is snapped back to reality so that she can prevent this disaster! Join her on a new mission throughout Spooky Isle and find a way to stop Imago’s devious plan.

219285.overview: Mother 3: Claus’s Journey, is a hack that switches the roles of main characters Lucas and Claus, making Claus into the main protagonist, which greatly changes the story due to Claus’s drastically different personality compared to Lucas. Much of the text and story is altered to better showcase Claus’s personality and thoughts, as well as how others react to him.

219321.overview: Mermaid Melody: Pichi Pichi Pitch is a licensed game developed by Konami and published for the Game Boy Advance platform. It takes inspiration from Dance Dance Revolution using music from the anime series of the same name.

418188.overview:
ADAM'S ORDERS
Samus, the space pirates have abandoned their base
on SR387 due to a rogue AI and are now asking us for help! I fear this
may be a trap, but we shouldn't waste any opportunity to strike them
at their core! Infiltrate their base and discover what vile secrets lie there...

Note: You start with Long Beam, Power Grip, and Morph Ball

418341.overview: Vulcalien's GBA demake of Minicraft, a 2D game made by Markus Persson (aka Notch) for the 22nd Ludum Dare.

421987.overview:
Moémon Mega FireRed is the most advanced Moémon game. It is specially curated to showcase the highest quality Moémon sprites that exist while posing some gameplay challenges.

Features:

Over 600 Moémon.
Fairy-Type.
Mega Evolution.
New areas.
Expanded moves.
Reusable TMs.
Physical/Special/Status split.

422064.overview:
Mooncat's Trio is a GBA remake of the classic Breakout. Everything is coded from scratch, with original music, handdrawn graphics and new game styles.

It was presented in the Revision 2018 demo party, where the game got #3 place in the Game competition.

422065.overview:
Misfortune Advance is a port/demake of a Gaming Creepypasta called Misfortune.GB. It was about a creepy hidden game in many Cartridges on the 1989 Game Boy.

In 2013, the game got a PC Port and this version is an adaptation of the PC Remake.

424961.overview: Race on the 20 tracks from one of the original SMK hacks: Mario Kart R, in Mario Kart: Super Circuit! Featuring edited palettes, changed menu and title screens and changed layouts!

440406.overview:
Imago is at it again! It now threatens the very existence of Halloween! Getting to Imago is no simple task! It has infiltrated a massive space pumpkin and sealed off all entrances. Legend says that every Halloween three Holy beings appear in the physical realm… perhaps with these spooks, as people call them, Samus can gain access to the pumpkin and save Halloween!

This hack was made for the Metconst 2017 Fall Contest, and is its winner. The hack consists of three large areas, a hub, and a final area. Average blind playthrough is about two hours. Linearity does not exist in this hack, so if you have difficulty in one place, try going elsewhere.

443855.overview: Mario Kart XXL is a Game Boy Advance tech demo created by Denaris Entertainment Software for Nintendo in 2004. It demonstrates the Game Boy Advance's ability to render and scale/rotate two different background layers. It was originally created as a non-Mario demo known as R3D-Demo before being repurposed.

448522.overview:
Mario’s Carnival Quest is a mod of Mario Party Advance to give the game a more fitting title, with a few quality of life tweaks added on top!

Features:
* Beautiful new title screen!
* Heavily reduced tedium!
* Start with 15 mushrooms instead of 3!
* Mushroom Challenges deal 10 mushrooms every 10 turns, instead of 3!

450169.overview: Samus Goes to the Fridge to Get a Glass of Milk is a humorous, short ROM hack of Metroid Fusion released in March 2020 for the Game Boy Advance (GBA). Created by developer kkzero, the meme-inspired game subverts the serious tone of the original franchise into a trivial midnight kitchen run.

451157.overview:
GRAVITY - Sylux’s Crusade is Roebloz’s third serious Metroid Zero Mission ROM hack and fifth overall, this time acting as a prequel to Metroid Prime 4, starring Sylux going through a Space Pirate research station fallen under the control of one of the many weapons onboard, an experimental Nightmare model stolen from the Galactic Federation, having gone rogue and now generating a black hole, which Sylux will attempt to stop from growing any bigger by destroying Nightmare as he runs through the station’s corridors, picking up various Chozo artifacts along the way.

Much like its predecessor, Crocomire’s Last Stand, GRAVITY attempts to provide a more open kind of exploration to the player, though it is much more experimental than the former, having been made for the MetroidConstruction Star Base contest hosted by MetroidMst, which included many restrictions, such as a maximum of 60 rooms overall. (Which Roebloz cleverly gets around by abusing the clause for elevator rooms being excluded, and by packing as many rooms as possible within one) It is truly open progression this time around however; The hack is playable in almost any order that the player chooses, as long as their skills are good enough to handle the tougher lower areas. It is rather short in length depending on how you play (At around 2 hours for a 100% playthrough), though of course if you decide to try and go for all of the ending images, it will last much longer, and thanks to all the different paths you can choose, there is near-endless replay value! Do you go for the strongest upgrades first, or do you stock up on Energy Tanks right away? The choice is yours!

451175.overview:
Galactic civilization is at an end. After successfully carrying out her mission to wipe out the Metroids on planet SR-388, legendary bounty hunter Samus Aran was attacked by the mysterious gelatinous lifeform known as ” X ” which the Metroids had been specifically designed to hunt by their creators, the Chozo. The parasite made quick work of her and the bounty hunter dropped dead minutes later, while a nigh-identical copy of her formed from the parasite, the SA-X…

The SA-X would take over Samus’s ship and, together with a few other X parasites, leave the planet to take over the galaxy with their power to easily kill and then mimic their prey. Over the next few months, both the Galactic Federation and Space Pirates would quickly be overwhelmed by the ever-growing parasitic lifeforms, with all of them becoming nothing but mutated copies. All of them? No! On the faraway Planet Nebov, a small group of indomitable Space Pirates still held out against the invaders, consisting of Kraid, Ridley and Crocomire, who had been sent there shortly before the X attacked Zebes to build a secondary Metroid Breeding Program in order to potentially find a vaccine to the virus. Multiple tests were conducted and the Space Pirates leaders managed to find Vaccine “Metroid”, and injected it into the planet’s inhabitants in order to make them immune to the X and be able to rebuild an army to eventually take down the parasites.

The vaccine proved to be successful, and even the strongest of the X mimics were unable to take over the planet, while its inhabitants lived a somewhat normal life, even having Crocomire hosting a live Metroidvania gameshow with the Zebesians as contestants! So now, as a last-ditch effort, the X hivemind is sending you, Samus Aran-X to take down the last obstacles to complete X domination.

Your objective is clear: MERCILESS EXTERMINATION.

451809.overview:
This hack substitutes the starter evolution lines for:

Metroid, Gamma Metroid and Omega Metroid
Birdie, Misterious Creature and Ridley
X Parasite, Core X and Barrier X
All starters can now be caught in the wild
And the legendary pokémon for:

Phantoon (Power plant)
Draygon (Seafoam Islands)
Kraid (Mt. Ember)
Mother Brain (Cerulean Cave)
They all have completely revamped movesets, types, base stats, abilities etc.

The female trainer sprites are changed to resemble Samus Aran as a Pokémon trainer.

The rival is changed to be your evil sister as a reference to Dark Samus. She will pick a complementary starter and has custom teams to go with them.

451829.overview:
Metroid: Scrolls 6 is a full, open-ended Metroid Zero Mission hack, originally made for the 2018 Berserker Contest made by Conner, OneOf99, CaptGlitch and JRP.
This version is an overhauled version of the original contest hack.

The hack has full graphical changes and a full original soundtrack.
Said soundtrack can also be listened to at SoundCloud.
You can play and explore 7 full areas and might also find things never used in a hack before.

About 1.0:
Scrolls 6 was originally released in 2018 for the Beserker Contest.
It is not recommended to play this version unless you want to specifically play
the contest version!

About 1.1:
This update adds new graphics and rooms.
It changes certain room layouts and overhauls some parts of certain areas.
A lot of bugs, including game breaking ones, have been fixed.
It is recommended to play this version for a first playthrough!

451841.overview:
Metroid FreezeFlame 2: Twisted Dimensions is the sequel to the 2020 released hack Metroid FreezeFlame. In comparison to the first entry in the FreezeFlame series, this hack is not entirely a heat run. Only a short portion in the beginning requires forced damage through heat! The hack was created for the Metroid Construction One Week Contest, which gave contestants one week to create a ROM-Hack or Fangame from scratch.

FreezeFlame 2 is a unique hack since it uses the portal elements from FreezeFLame 1 to put the players in worlds formerly only known from other ROM-Hacks. It is reccommended that the player is at least a bit familiar with other Metroid: Zero Mission ROM-Hacks to have a truly good time with this hack.

ROM-Hacks featured in this hack:

FreezeFlame
Spooky Mission
Deep Freeze
SR387
Subzero
Return to Zebes
Scrolls 6
Stargazer

458402.overview: The mandarin has been hired for a new mission, General Limoncello has stolen the plans for a new space station under construction and without them it is impossible to finish it, find them and kill General Limoncello.

459713.overview: An early prototype of an unreleased port of Metal Slug: Super Vehicle-001 for the Nintendo Game Boy Advance.

459933.overview:
You enter the mazezam on the left and you have to get to the exit on the right by pushing rows of blocks left and right.
If you get stuck you can retry the mazezam, but this will cost you a life.

461207.overview: Extensive Metroid Fusion romhack that aims to enable sequence breaking and brings several other improvements.

463018.overview: Metroid: Oil Spill is a Fusion hack testing the waters and interest in a non linear Fusion.

463019.overview: Area LC-13. It used to be a fertile piece of land, where there were many species. However, the water source here suddenly dried up, the land became a desert, and many species perished. I've come here to find out the reason for the disappearance of water source.

464565.overview: Moémon Star Emerald is a popular Game Boy Advance (GBA) Pokémon ROM hack created by developer Axcellerator. It transforms the classic Pokémon Emerald into an expanded, high-quality "Vanilla+" anime-style adventure. The core mechanic replaces all standard Pokémon sprites with "Moémon"—humanised, female, and "moe" anime-girl versions of the creatures.

467499.overview: Mintroid is a rom hack of Metroid: Zero Mission, it was an attempt to create something short and fun while limited to a 10x10 minimap space. The minty theme put on top is just for some extra fun.

468166.overview:
The Space Pirates are operating an illegal salt quarry. It is up to renowned bounty-hunter Samus Aran to put a stop to their plans.

A Zero-Mission hack like you've never seen! Featuring many twists, turns, puzzles, an entirely new planet to explore, and a heart-wrenching story to hit you right in your feels! Experience Metroid saltier than ever before!

468171.overview: A Metroid Zero Mission hack made in less than 24 hours.

468172.overview:
We got a message that the Space Pirates are trying to clone Ridley after I killed
him on my mission on Zebes. They succeeded with the clone and injected him the
ability to be immun to ice. They send him on a test mission to freeze an entire
Planet. I followed Ice-Ridley to the Planet and explored it as Ice-Ridley froze
the Planet. I saw all the friendly creatures freeze in front of me... my Varia
suit saved me. Now I gotta kill Ice-Ridley and unfreeze the planet.

468870.overview: A short ROM hack of Metroid Zero Mission.

470012.overview:
This hack adopts the perspective of Juste Belmont’s friend and rival, Maxim Kischine.

The linear plot of the game remains true to the original, but with Maxim’s tale being the central focus while Juste takes a secondary role. However, Juste is still playable as an extra character in the same way Maxim was initially.

Certain items have been tweaked to suit Maxim over Juste. In the same manner, Maxim does not have access to certain items that Juste normally would. For example, the only sub weapons Maxim can utilize are the knife, axe and shuriken. And, as in the original, these gain magical properties when paired with Spell Books.

There are two patches for this hack.

The first contains the new story with the original palettes for everything. This is included for the Castlevania “purist” who desires a canonical feel for the hack.

The second, and preferred patch to use, showcases many palette changes that gives a much more detailed and appropriate feel for the game, itself. This version also removes the outlines to the main characters and causes them to not be so pronounced.

470365.overview: Project ZM is a work-in-progress vanilla+ hack for the North American (U) Metroid Zero Mission ROM. It is designed to fix errors and add new gameplay routes, tricks and mechanics

470723.overview:
Includes 8 patches:
1. Mario Kart Super Circuit Music Restoration by "Run the Coins"
2. 60 FPS Patch by Antimattur
3. Localized Voices by "Emilianomario27"
4. Mario Kart 64 Yoshi's Voice v1.0 by Mister Man
5. Widescreen patch by "gamemasterplc"
6. Better Colors v1.1 by "N.Dpendent"
7. Original Sunset Wilds title card & sprites by "SCD"
8. No Bumpy Ice by Seiken

470998.overview: In this frantic arcade-style game, you take control of Manolo, a tireless worker with a clear mission: repair every broken window on the facade. But this is no peaceful gig; time is ticking, and danger lurks on every level of the scaffolding.
